{{Short description|German mathematician}}
[[File:George Rosenhain.JPG|thumb|]]
'''Johann Georg Rosenhain''' (10 June 1816 in Königsberg – 14 March 1887  Berlin) was a German mathematician who introduced [[theta characteristic]]s.<ref>{{MacTutor|id=Rosenhain}}</ref>

Rosenhain was born to a Jewish family, to Nathan Rosenhain and Röschen Joseph.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Johann Rosenhain - Biography|url=https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Biographies/Rosenhain/|access-date=2021-06-09|website=Maths History|language=en}}</ref>
